fact: LuxDev's April 2025 sheet for programme BKF/025 (52.2 MEUR: Luxembourg 46.2, European Union 6; May 2018 to December 2025, anchored in the education ministry) states that its 2023-2025 extension includes improving the results of the pilot phase and extending the FIUE-BF, that 120 census agents were trained for the FIUE-BF, and that in 2023 all establishments of the pilot phase had dematerialised online enrolment, publication of school results and production of school identity cards.
title: Programme d'appui pour la mise en œuvre du Plan sectoriel de l'éducation et de la formation (BKF/025)
